entries.english: Open England’s Farming Advice Service page from the UK country review.
entries.st: Bula leqephe la Tšebeletso ea Keletso ea Temo la England ho tsoa tlhahlobong ea naha ea UK.
entries.ts: Pfula phepha ra Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi bya England ku suka eka nhlelo wa tiko ra UK.
entries.ve: Vulani siaṱari la Tshumelo ya Nyeletshedzo ya Vhulimi la England u bva kha tsedzuluso ya shango la UK.
entries.zu: Vula ikhasi le-Farming Advice Service lase-England kusuka ekubuyekezweni kwezwe lase-UK.

entries.st: Fumana tšupiso ea keletso ea England
entries.ts: Kuma xikombo xa switsundzuxo swa England
entries.ve: Wananani ndaedzo ya nyeletshedzo ya England

entries.english: Choose the United Kingdom and open Agricultural extension to find the GOV.UK link.
entries.st: Kgetha United Kingdom ebe o bula Keletso ea temo ho fumana sehokelo sa GOV.UK.
entries.ts: Hlawula United Kingdom kutani u pfula Switsundzuxo swa vurimi ku kuma xihlanganisi xa GOV.UK.
entries.ve: Nangani United Kingdom ni vule Nyeletshedzo ya vhulimi u itela u wana tshitanganyi tsha GOV.UK.
entries.zu: Khetha i-United Kingdom bese uvula Ezolimo zokweluleka ukuze uthole isixhumanisi se-GOV.UK.
